iti108:2.1: ye keci bhikkhave bhikkhū kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī unnaḷā asamāhitā. na me te bhikkhave bhikkhū māmakā
iti108:2.2: apagatā ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā na ca te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjanti.
iti108:2.3: ye ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhū nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā athaddhā susamāhitā te ca kho me bhikkhave bhikkhū māmakā
iti108:2.4: anapagatā ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā imasmiṃ ca te dhammavinaye vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantīti.
